en.html:
In the end I could not accept. The killings connected with the Silver Star were already my limit.

To fight and kill for the future of Yamato was a job for a bigger man than me. Turning my back on the prince, to whom I owed so much, pained me. But what could I do? Nothing.

Luckily, neither the prince nor the Chief tried to order me. They did not even press me to keep quiet about it—that goes without saying—and after one silent nod they simply let me leave.

So it was not my doing. Not at all. No need to dig through my memory to confirm that. Someone else had brought Moriuji Ashikaga to his death.

If it was not a natural death—if an assassin's hand had been there—

then I could not help suspecting the shadow of the Maidono prince behind it.

But who had played the blade in my place? Anyone, at the prince's side? A man capable of finishing Moriuji Ashikaga?

Nobody came to mind...

ja.html:
結局、俺は引き受けることができなかった。
　銀星号に<ruby>纏<rt>まつ</rt></ruby>わる殺戮だけで限界だった。

　大和の未来の為に戦い殺すなど、俺の器量を超えて
いた。
　恩ある親王の期待に背くのは心苦しい。だが仕様も
ない。

　幸い、親王も署長も強いて命じようとはしなかった。
　念を押して口止めするようなこともなく――そんな
のは当たり前だ――無言で頷いたきり、俺が退出する
に任せてくれた。

　だから、俺の仕業ではない。断じて。わざわざ記憶
を反芻して確認するまでもない事だが。
　足利護氏を死に至らしめた者は別にいる。

　自然死ではなく、刺客の手が存在したなら……
　
　やはりその奥に、舞殿宮の影を疑わずにはおれない。

　しかし、誰が俺に代わって刃の役を務め上げたのか。
　誰か……いただろうか？　親王の側に、足利護氏を
仕留め得るような者が。

　心当たりはないが……。

舞殿宮"Aah... finally I can settle down. Honestly, my shoulders have turned to stone."
Chief"A tiring session, Highness."
舞殿宮"You also, na. But Kenchouji... in the sense of being right under the Ashikaga nose, not much different from the castle."
Chief"Still, Highness... better than being kept inside Fudaraku Castle forever."
舞殿宮"That is true... Chalo, leave all that."
舞殿宮"Straight to the main matter, then. ...What do you think?"
Chief"..."
